tei:div.tei:p: )bka' rdzogs pa chen po yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi phrin las rang gzhung bzhugs so: le'u dang po ni/ them yig lag len ngo sprod kyi: skal ldan myur grol gdams pa bshad: ces dang : phrin las rang gzhung bstan pa ni: bkra shis byin chags dben gnas su: zhes pas: dang po las byang bstan pa ni: da la gtor mchod bkod pa'i bye brag rnams: bag bro rgyan ldan rol mo dbyangs dang bcas: sku gsung thugs rten mdzes shing yid 'ong bkram: mtshams gcod srung 'khor skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang : yan lag bdun pa mchod pa byin rlabs bya: ting 'dzin gsal zhing bskyed rim spyan 'dren mchod: bstod pa sngags bzlas tshogs mchod rjes las so: dang po lta ba'i mtshams gcod pa ni: hrīḥ bdag nyid 'gyur med ye nas rdo rje'i sku: phyi nang snod bcud gzhal yas skye 'gro lha: phyogs dang phyogs mtshams 'ja' 'od mtshon chas gtams: rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me ris bskor: oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa dz+wa la raṃ: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: skyabs gnas dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi: rgyud drug 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i pha ma rnams: bzod med gdung bas sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir: kun kyang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: yan lag bdun pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos rnams thams cad sku gsum rang bzhin la: gnyis med klong yangs chen por phyag 'tshal lo: ma bcos mtha' bral mnyam pa nyid kyis mchod: rang sems sangs rgyas ma rtogs mthol lo bshags: gnas lugs rang rig ngang du yi rang ngo : 'dzin med khyab brdal rol pa'i chos 'khor bskor: 'khor 'das dbyer med bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs: chos dbyings lhun grub chen po bsngo bar bya: zung 'jug kun khyab bde chen mchog thob shog: mchod pa byin brlab ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: rang gi gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum gyis mtshan: de las zer ma phyogs bcur rab 'phros pas:

mchod rdzas dngos 'dzin rnam rtog bag chags kun: nyes skyon bsregs gtor sbyangs bkrus bdud rtsir gyur: sman raka gtor mchod 'od phung ldems se ldem: bla med mchod pa dpag yas bsam mi khyab: oṃ bh+rūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ ting nge 'dzin ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'di ltar snang srid gnyis bsdus chos rnams kun: ye nas stong zhing nam mkha' lta bu la: gzung 'dzin spang blang bya byed mtha' las 'das: pad+ma saṃ bha bdag ni de ltar smra: dharmā dhā tu swa bha wa āḥhūm̐: dngos gzhi lha bskyed pa ni: hrī: bdag nyid tha mal rang sems bzo med 'di: dkon mchog spyi 'dus pad+ma 'od 'bar sku: dkar gsal mdangs lnga mdzes 'dzum rgyan gyis spras: rdo rje thod pa tshe bum rin chen brgyan: pad zhwa rgod ldem kha ṭ+waṃ g.yon nas 'khril: phod ka chos gos za 'og ber phyam can: mtshan dpes rab brgyan 'od kyi dkyil 'khor mdzes: mnyam nyid bde chen 'khyil ba'i skyil krung bzhugs: 'od kyi lus la ye shes snying po can: gsal stong thugs rje'i 'od zer kun la snyoms: mkha' 'gro'i 'ja' sprin rnam mang 'khrigs pa'i dbus: sku yi sprul pas zhing khams yongs la khyab: nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogs pa med: bde gshegs kun gyi bkod pa sku la rdzogs: kun kyang rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor zang thal le: bgegs dang bar chad zhes bya'i ming yang med: snang stong sgyu ma tsam du gsal bar bskyed: de ltar du gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: de las 'od zer 'phros pas zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas: o rgyan gyi gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas la 'khor rgyal ba rab 'byams kyis bskor ba til gyi gong bu kha bye ba ltar dpag tu med pa spyan drangs: spyan 'dren pa ni: hrī: sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes:

pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sel: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ phyag 'tshal ni: na mo: skye 'gag 'gyur med 'phrin las rdzogs: rang byung thugs rjes 'gro rnams sgrol: yid bzhin dngos grub char 'bebs pa'i: pad+ma 'od 'bar sku la phyag 'tshal lo: mchod pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: mchod 'os phyi nang snod bcud kun: blo yis sprul lam lhun gyis grub: ting 'dzin mnyam nyid chen po ru: dkon mchog spyi 'dus rgyal bar 'bul: gzhan yang mchod pa'i bye brag ni: mdzes pa'i me tog dbu la 'bul: dri zhim bdug spos shangs la 'bul: snang gsal mar me spyan la 'bul: mchod yon dri chab sku la 'bul: ro ldan zhal zas ljags la 'bul: snyan pa'i rol mo thugs la 'bul: phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa 'bul: bstod dbyangs glu yi mchod pa 'bul: 'dod yon ma spangs phyi mchod 'bul: nyon mongs ma spangs nang mchod 'bul: 'du 'bral med pa'i gsang mchod 'bul: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar sman mchod 'bul: dug lnga bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'bul: ba liṃ gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: blang dor med pa'i mchod pa 'bul: ar+ghaṃ/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+ta pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: ma hā pañca rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: bstod pa ni: hrīḥ rgyal ba thams cad ye shes klong du gcig: chos nyid don la cha lugs mi mnga' yang : thabs mkhas gang 'dul so so'i skur ston pa: thugs rjes sprul bsgyur 'gyed la phyag 'tshal bstod: bde gshegs kun 'dus gzhon nu lo brgyad tshul: 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs mgon pad+ma 'byung :

'gyur med sku mdog gangs la nyi shar ltar: dmar dmangs cung zad 'tsher la phyag 'tshal bstod: thabs shes dbyer med rdo rje thod pa dang : zung 'jug tshe dang ye shes bum pa 'dzin: dug gsum rtsad gcod kha ṭ+wāṃ yum gyi tshul: khro 'dzum 'gro 'dul mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: chos gos dmar po gser gyi ha ris can: she'u'i snyan zhu rgod ldem dar sna 'phyang : pad+ma'i gdan la mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar: phyi nang yon tan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku dang zhing khams ye nas 'du 'bral med: phyogs bcu kun kyang rgyal ba'i cho 'phrul las: che chung ma nges sku gsum ngang du bzhugs: sprul pa'i glog stong 'khyug la phyag 'tshal bstod: gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od zer gyis: tshe yi dngos grub rang bzhin gnas nas 'gugs: dgos 'dod re skong yid bzhin mchog gi ngang : 'chi med rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: de ltar mchod dang bstod bya mi dmigs kyang : glo bur dri ma'i rnam rtog sel phyir du: thabs shes dbyer med chu la chu bzhag tshul: gnyis med rol pa chen por phyag 'tshal bstod: bzlas pa bskul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ shin+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā: nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags ngan: sdang dgra gnod byed gdug pa'i dbal: rno ba'i mtshon dang sbyor ba'i dug: stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs kun dang : bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams dang : rmi ltas mtshan ngan thams cad kun: myur ba nyid du zhi gyur cig: rtsa sngags sham du: bh+rūm̐ puṣ+ṭaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: tshe dang bsod nams snyan grags stobs: 'khor dang bu slob phrin las rgyas: mnga' thang longs spyod yon tan kun: myur ba nyid du rgyas gyur cig: rtsa sngags sham du: hrīḥwa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rgyal ba'i thugs rje byin rlabs dang : skye 'gro mthong thos dran reg kun: khams gsum dbang du 'dus gyur cig: rtsa sngags sham du:

hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭa: bdag cag rnams la gnod pa'i bgegs: dam sri 'byung po ma rungs pa: bstan dgra sgos dgra la sogs pa: zhing bcu ldan rnams brlag gyur cig: ༁ྃ: bka' rdzogs pa chen po yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus las: 'chi med tshe sgrub lcags kyi ri bo bzhugs so: ༁ྃ: hrī: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid: 'gro rnams ma lus sgrol ba'i ded dpon mchog: o rgyan pad+ma rig 'dzin tshe dpag med: bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum byin rlobs la: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dang : rkyen ngan nyi khri chig stong dang : ye 'grogs sum brgya drug bcu dang : bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu sogs: tshe yi bar chad mi mthun rkyen: thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig: hrī: phyi ni bum pa nang ni bdud rtsis gang : gsang ba'i don ni pad+ma tshe dpag med: gnas lngar phyag mtshan lnga dang yig 'bru lnga'i: 'od zer dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar 'phros: hrīḥ shar phyogs dri za'i lag nas lcags kyus khug: lho phyogs gshin rje'i lag nas zhags pas khug: nub phyogs klu bdud lag nas lcags sgrog khug: byang phyogs gnod sbyin lag nas dril bus khug: steng phyogs tshangs pa brgya byin lag nas khug: 'og phyogs dga' bo 'jog po'i lag nas khug: tshe srog chad pa mthud la yar ba khug: gas pa sbyor la nyams pa thams cad gsos: 'od zer dkar la 'tsher zhing snum la 'dril: spyi bo'i gtsug nas lus la sib sib thim: 'od 'bar 'chi med tshe yi dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi a yu ṣe hūm̐ nri dzaḥ hrīḥ dang po chos kyi dbyings kyi rgya: gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya: gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya: bzhi pa ye shes bzhi yi rgya: lnga pa sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i rgya: drug pa bcom ldan thub drug rgya: bdun pa sangs rgyas rab bdun rgya: phyag rgya bdun gyis rgyas gdab bo:
pad+ma'i yang sprul rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying pos gter nas gdan drangs pa'o:
